dct_description_sm: Malawi administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 3 - Admin 2: 32 - Admin 3: 433 Dates associated with this dataset: - 04 October 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 05 April 2023: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 22 October 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 22 October 2018: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
